toolsPreview.description: Creates a free, provider-neutral mobile-data estimate and readiness checklist for a travel route. Use it for data budgeting, device preparation, hotspot planning, offline readiness, and connection fallback advice. It does not browse, compare, promote, recommend, price, sell, or link to products, plans, carriers, or connectivity services.
